title: Adaptive2D Outside: the fig8 path order changes with small mesh changes

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Found during the work on #2754.

## What we saw

The test `fig8_outside_containment_with_em0800_and_clearing_kinds_works` (`crates/app/tests/shoulder_adaptive.rs`) asserts that the last feed move ends at the selected face (distance = tool radius).

During #2754, a trial mesh of `fig8.step` divided the boundary edges of the cone faces by 2.0 in place of 1.5. That mesh is also full fidelity (chord 0.005 mm). The changes to the part were small:

- The outline Y range went from `-29.99511 .. 166.015336` to `-30.0 .. 166.017784`.
- The outer outline loop went from 2520 to 3489 points.

With that mesh, the Adaptive2D path did not end at the wall. After the wall pass (moves 1721-1935) it retracted and cut two more rings at the stock edge (moves 1939-1956, x = +/-51.5). The last feed ended 31.406 mm from the part. The minimum distance to the part stayed 3.999-4.000 mm, so there was no gouge.

The divisor that #2754 ships (1.5) gives a path that ends at the wall, and the test passes. The trial divisor is not on any branch.

## Why it matters

The path order of Adaptive2D with Outside containment changes a lot for a small change of the mesh. A later importer change can make the test red again, or end a user's path with an air ring after the finish pass.

## Done means

- Find why a stock-edge ring can be cut after the wall pass (rest region, region split, or order rule).
- Make the wall pass the last pass, or record why the order is correct.
- A pinning test with a small perturbation of the part outline.
